jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a village courtyard in daylight in thin white line art: houses, a tree, a stone path. Scene: side view: a big calm elephant drawn all in WHITE with four legs, two ears, one trunk and one tail stands on the right, its long trunk hanging down in front of it; ONE blind man drawn all in WHITE with a white robe, white skin, eyes closed stands on the left in front of the elephant's head and holds the elephant's trunk with both hands, a surprised face. The elephant is WHITE-filled with thin dark outlines, NOT black, NOT a dark silhouette; it is big and fully in the frame. Only one man and the elephant. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
